name: AI & ML Security
description: Security assessment of artificial intelligence and machine learning systems. Covers adversarial robustness, training pipeline integrity, model confidentiality, LLM and generative AI red teaming, prompt injection, agentic and retrieval-augmented systems, ML infrastructure security, AI threat modelling, and security evaluation methodology. Aligned with the MITRE ATLAS framework.

categories.name: Adversarial ML
categories.description: Assessment of ML model robustness, training data integrity, and model confidentiality. Covers evasion attacks, data and model poisoning, and privacy attacks such as extraction and inversion.

categories.name: LLM & Generative AI
categories.description: Security assessment of large language models and generative AI systems. Covers red-team campaign methodology, prompt injection, output integrity, guardrail evaluation, agentic AI and tool-use risks, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines.

categories.name: ML Operations Security
categories.description: Security of the ML development and deployment lifecycle. Covers model supply chain, dependency integrity, serving infrastructure, pipeline access control, AI system threat modelling, and security evaluation methodology.
